text:
Predicates:
EatSalad(x) ::: x eats salads regularly.
Conscious(x) ::: x is very conscious about their health and eating habits.
GrewUpHealthConscious(x) ::: x grew up in a health-conscious childhood home.
FulfillIntake(x) ::: x fulfills their nutritional daily intakes.
GoodRelationship(x) ::: x has good relationships with their parents.
VisitGym(x) ::: x visits the gym at least once a day.
Taylor ::: Taylor

Premises:
∀x (EatSalad(x) → Conscious(x)) ::: All people who eat salads regularly are very conscious about their health and eating habits.
∀x (GrewUpHealthConscious(x) → EatSalad(x)) ::: All people who grew up in health-conscious childhood homes eat salads regularly.
∀x (FulfillIntake(x) → GrewUpHealthConscious(x)) ::: All people who fulfill their nutritional daily intakes grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
∀x (GoodRelationship(x) → FulfillIntake(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they fulfill their nutritional daily intakes.
∀x (GoodRelationship(x) → ¬EatSalad(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they do not eat salads regularly.
∀x (VisitGym(x) → FulfillIntake(x)) ::: If people visit the gym at least once a day, then they always fulfill their daily nutritional intakes.
(GrewUpHealthConscious(Taylor) ∧ GoodRelationship(Taylor)) ⊕ ¬(GrewUpHealthConscious(Taylor) ∨ GoodRelationship(Taylor)) ::: It is either both true that Taylor grew up in a health-conscious childhood home and she has a good relationship with her parents, or it is true that Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor has a good relationship with her parents.

Conclusion:
EatSalad(Taylor) ::: Taylor eats salads regularly.
